DICOMweb, HL7 FHIR, DuckDB Cohort Indexing, and OMOP MI-CDM

Source: vignettes/interop_fhir_and_omop.Rmd
interop_fhir_and_omop.Rmd

Overview

dicomtk 0.5.0 introduces standards-compliant medical imaging interoperability:

  1. DICOMweb (PS3.18): as_dicom_json(), from_dicom_json(), pack_multipart_dicom(), unpack_multipart_dicom(), dicomweb_qido(), dicomweb_wado(), dicomweb_stow(), and dicomweb_metadata() with OAuth2/Bearer/Basic authentication.
  2. HL7 FHIR R4/R5: as_fhir_imaging_study(), from_fhir_imaging_study(), as_fhir_imaging_selection(), as_fhir_diagnostic_report(), as_fhir_provenance(), as_w3c_prov(), and link_synthea_cohort().
  3. DuckDB / Parquet Archive Index & Guardrailed NL-to-SQL: dicom_index_build(), dicom_index_query(), validate_readonly_sql(), dicom_cohort_nl(), export_cohort_spec(), and run_cohort_spec().
  4. OHDSI OMOP MI-CDM: to_omop_image_occurrence(), to_omop_image_feature(), and write_omop_micdm() backed by omop_imaging_concepts.

1. Archive Index & Guardrailed NL-to-SQL Cohort Builder 

library(dicomtk)

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 3L), phi_profile = "basic")
idx <- dicom_index_build(synth[["out_dir"]])

cohort <- dicom_cohort_nl(idx, "CT series with at least 2 instances")
cohort$sql
#> [1] "SELECT SeriesInstanceUID, StudyInstanceUID, Modality, SeriesDescription, BodyPartExamined, SliceThickness, n_instances FROM series WHERE Modality = 'CT' AND n_instances >= 2"
cohort$results
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   SeriesInstanceUID StudyInstanceUID Modality SeriesDescription BodyPartExamined
#>   <chr>             <chr>            <chr>    <chr>             <chr>           
#> 1 2.25.17946644579… 2.25.1794664457… CT       ""                ""              
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: SliceThickness <dbl>, n_instances <int>

2. HL7 FHIR ImagingStudy & OHDSI OMOP MI-CDM 

vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])
fhir_study <- as_fhir_imaging_study(vol, patient_ref = "Patient/p-001")
fhir_study$resourceType
#> [1] "ImagingStudy"

occ <- to_omop_image_occurrence(idx)
occ[, c("image_occurrence_id", "modality_concept_id", "image_study_uid")]
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   image_occurrence_id modality_concept_id image_study_uid                    
#>                 <int>               <int> <chr>                              
#> 1                   1             4300757 2.25.179466445798503421600000010001

dicom_index_close(idx)
unlink(synth[["out_dir"]], recursive = TRUE)
